A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the reliability of the qPCR step is good, and that the measurement error in the quantification is due to all the steps of the procedure.

the measurement errors in qPCR-based gene expression quantifications are due to the manual steps that precede the final qPCR step, and the best improvement would be obtained by replicating the cell culture.
the measurement errors due not only to the PCR step but also to all steps of the gene expression quantification process should be considered in studies of gene expression.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the measurement of gene-expression levels in cell lines is not as precise as it is often assumed.
the measurement errors in gene expression quantification are high, and they are due to manual steps that can be improved by replication.
the reliability of gene expression quantification is not as good as the reliability of qPCR.
